summary: Four listed churches in Rome and Lee Center. The parish Mass schedule box (weekday at St. Peter's, Saturday at St. John's, St. Paul's and St. Joseph's, Sunday at St. John's and St. Peter's), Friday 5-6 PM Confession at St. Peter's and Tuesday 5-6 PM Adoration at St. Joseph's agree in all five bulletins. Open: a daily 7 AM-7 PM Adoration box that names no church (seven grouped slots, leaning leave out). First-Friday Solemn Vespers is left out as not Adoration.
